theme.darkDesc: Cosmic night atmosphere inspired by RPGs and galaxies. Deep purple background with ethereal orbs, ideal for dim environments and lower eye strain.
theme.lightDesc: Cosmic Daylight palette for visual comfort. Cool neutral alabaster background, crisp white cards, and editorial slate typography.
theme.statusDark: Cosmic Dark Theme is active as your primary visual theme.
theme.statusLight: Cosmic Daylight Light Theme is active for comfortable daytime use.

experienceMode.gamifiedDesc: Reward estimate panel always visible in forms, sword icons for task difficulty, and prominent XP and Gold earnings across lists.
experienceMode.productivityDesc: Clean executive interface focused on execution. Hides reward estimates from modals and popovers, uses discreet effort dots, and runs gamification silently in the background.
experienceMode.statusGamified: RPG Immersion (Gamified) — Visible rewards, sword difficulty icons, and prominent XP and Coins.
experienceMode.statusProductivity: Focus & Productivity (Minimalist) — Clean interface with hidden reward estimates and direct task focus.

languageCard.enDesc: Display the entire interface in English.
languageCard.ptDesc: Display the entire interface in Brazilian Portuguese.
languageCard.statusEn: English (US) is active as your primary interface language.

compactMode.compactDesc: Smaller cards, calendars, and lists. Optimizes screen space to view more tasks and reward items at once. Recommended for higher productivity.
compactMode.comfortableDesc: Generous paddings and standard typography. Ideal for large screens or those who prefer relaxed spacing and larger elements.
compactMode.statusCompact: Compact Mode is active for maximum content density.
compactMode.statusComfortable: Comfortable Mode is active with generous spacing.
